layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Pachycephalosaurus peer-size comparison
features: A full-body side view of a Pachycephalosaurus made of green clay with a thick, dome-shaped red clay skull
Standing face-to-face with the dinosaur is a simple clay figure of a child in a blue jumpsuit
The dinosaur and the child are exactly the same height, showing an eye-to-eye comparison
The dinosaur has a thick tail and small arms, with a curious and friendly expression
Clean, minimalist clay sculpts with smooth surfaces on a seamless off-white background
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic wide shot on a seamless off-white studio background. The focus is purely on the matched height of the two figures. Strictly no text or labels.
